appraisal_events.evidence: Le nouveau salon ne manquait pas... d'agrément... tous les gens les plus intéressants, les plus variés, les femmes les plus élégantes de Paris [étaient] ravis de profiter du luxe des Verdurin qui, grâce à leur fortune, allait croissant à une époque où les plus riches se restreignaient.
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite wartime shortages that force others to retrench, the narrator shows Mme Verdurin's salon relocating in style and continuing to draw the most brilliant Parisian society, with her wealth actually increasing, marking a clear local elevation of her social standing and drawing power.

appraisal_events.evidence: Odette, qui en avait un aussi beau [collier], de l'exhibition duquel elle-même avait abusé, regardait, maintenant qu'elle était en «tenue de guerre» à l'imitation des dames du faubourg, avec sévérité [les toilettes éclatantes des dames nouvelles].
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette now judges newly arrived women's ostentatious jewelry with severity, but the narrator pointedly notes she herself had once overindulged in the very same display, ironically undercutting the authority of her new severe, faubourg-imitating pose.

status_effects.explanation: Her salon's continued and even growing brilliance and luxury amid wartime hardship marks a clear local elevation of her social position and influence.
Odette's assumed severity and authority in judging others' taste is locally undercut by narratorial irony recalling her own past excess with the very same kind of ostentation.

ambiguities: The narrator's account of the Verdurins' growing fortune 'while the richest were cutting back' carries a possible implicit critique of wartime profiteering that complicates a purely positive reading of the salon's elevation.
